_note: Model tiers for the local side-work agent on a 16 GB card (Radeon RX 9060 XT). Tags and sizes come from third-party summaries of the Ollama library, so confirm with `ollama list` / `ollama pull`. approx_gb is the Q4_K_M download size; weights plus KV cache must fit in vram_gb to stay fully on the GPU.

fast.note: quick edits and docs; weakest at multi-file reasoning

main.note: dense 14B coder; the default. Fits with 16K context on 16 GB

general.note: general model with a thinking mode; better for planning and prose, slower

stretch.note: MoE coder; does not fit in 16 GB, so part runs on the CPU. Measure speed before relying on it
